learning_outcomes.text: Model, analyze, and calculate the static equilibrium of solids.
Analyze, describe, and calculate the planar motion of particles and solids.
Know and apply the fundamentals of fluid statics and dynamics.
Identify, analyze, and calculate oscillatory and wave phenomena.
Know and apply the fundamentals of thermodynamics.
Know the basic principles and laws governing heat transfer.
Know the general laws governing the behavior of electric and magnetic fields and apply them to problem-solving.
Know, use, and manipulate physical quantities appropriately and rigorously.
Be able to perform experimental tests in the physics laboratory, as well as analyze, evaluate, and interpret the obtained results.
Be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

assessment_rules: Continuous evaluation consists of two exams (40% each), seminar assessment (12%), and laboratory assessment (8%). The ordinary call consists of a single exam worth 100% of the grade.
